Class AsyncFramework.SaveResult

@TestVisible
private class AsyncFramework.SaveResult

Wrapper class for database upsert operation results. Provides simplified access to operation outcomes and error information for AsyncJob__c record persistence.

public List<Database.Error> getErrors()

Retrieves any errors that occurred during the upsert operation.

Returns:
    Array of Database.Error objects describing failures, or null if no errors or result is null.

public Id getId()

Retrieves the record Id from the upsert operation result.

Returns:

public Boolean isSuccess()

Indicates whether the upsert operation was successful.

Returns:
